fix: Native STEP export omits optional pcurves and validates actual exported files by strict re-import in both coordinate frames. CAD surfaces and 3D curves are retained.
remainingLimitations: Two public STEP source files pass standard but fail exact BRep checks, independently reproduced with OpenCascade.
